svg.title: Motors R and L
svg.desc: Two 28BYJ-48 motors through their ULN2003 boards, powered by the external 5 V supply.

svg.text: Motors R and L: ULN2003 boards + 28BYJ-48
Motor R on D2–D5, motor L on D6–D9, IN1 to IN4 in order (HwConfig.h: STEPPER_MOTOR_R_PIN0..3, STEPPER_MOTOR_L_PIN0..3)
+5 V from the external supply (also to the Nano's 5V pin)
The external supply feeds the motors and the Nano's 5V pin (in SD mode the USB port is not connected); its ground is the Nano's.
